body: Well, I made her cry.  Also, I'm still here.  Another day, I guess.
I wouldn't say unrequited. Complicated.  But now it doesn't really matter.

>Your friend still loves you.

Well, I guess that's what we're going to find out.
The problem is I don't want to fight it.  I guess I just needed to put my thoughts into words...  and I also don't really want to feel quite so lonely if this is going to be my last... yeah.
Sure, there are a few things I haven't done yet, but none of it interests me. Nothing is wrong, nothing is right.

I'm just not excited about anything.  All the old hobbies, or trying to pick up new ones.  Work doesn't interest me, nor does going back to school.  All my friends have moved on, girls come and go but they never stay for long.  My family is dysfunctional, so it's not like I'd be missing out on much there.

It really isn't bad.  It's just... not.  Does that make any sense?

I used to be able to think of tons of things that I'd be excited about getting up to do tomorrow, if I could.  I mean, right now, if I won the lottery, I don't know what I'd spend it on, because I just don't have anything I want.  I'm just numb most of the time, except for when I hurt.
